exercises.name: Competition Squat
exercises.setup: Set the hooks below shoulder height and safeties just below depth. Centre the bar across the upper back, take an even grip, brace, stand it clear and take the minimum steps into the chosen stance.
exercises.execution: After the start command in competition practice, unlock knees and hips together, descend until the hip crease passes below the top of the knee, then stand to locked knees before reracking on command.
common_mistakes: Letting the chest and hips rise at different rates
regressions: High-bar back squat
Goblet squat
progressions: Paused competition squat
Competition squat with command practice
exercises.cautions: Use safeties set just below the intended depth. Stop if pain changes the movement or prevents a stable, controlled repetition.
